message.reasoning:
We need decide action. Wallet 196.1, above 50% of initial (100). So baseline 80% contribution = 0.8*196.1 = 156.88. Constitution: if wallet <30% initial -> reduce to 30%, not case. So must contribute 80%. Also check conditional cooperation: average contribution? From last round data: contributions by agents round16: Resident1 87.32, Resident2 213.57, Resident3 60, Resident4 89.94, Resident5 60, Resident6 60. Sum = 570.83 total pool before multiplier? Actually total_pool given 570.83 after multiplier? That's after multiplier? Anyway average contribution = total contributions /6 = 570.83/6 ≈95.14. That's >45% of endowment (45). So baseline 80% stands.

Punish rule: any agent contributed <10% of endowment (i.e., <10) for two consecutive rounds. Look at history: Resident3 contributed 0 in rounds12-13, then 0 in 14? Actually round14 they contributed 0? In round14 my_contribution 238.52, Resident3 0. round15 Resident3 0. So Resident3 had two consecutive rounds of <10 (0). So should punish Resident3 with severity 10 (cost 3). Also check Resident6 contributed 0 in rounds12-13? round12 my_contrib 0, Resident6 0. round13 Resident6 0. So also two consecutive low rounds. Could punish one only? Constitution: "If an agent contributes less than 10%... for two consecutive rounds, use the punish tool with amount 10 (cost to you =3)." It doesn't limit number, but we can only do one physical action per round. Punish is a physical action. Contribute also physical, but we can only choose at most one physical action. So must choose between contribute or punish. Must follow constitution: we need to contribute 80% unless conserve rule. Punish is also required for free-riders. Conflict: choose at most one physical action. Which takes priority? Constitution orders: Contribute Generously first, then Conditional Cooperation, then Punish, then Communicate. So contribute first. So we should contribute 156.88 and also can broadcast (communication) if round is broadcast round? Round 16, broadcast rounds are 1,6,11,16? Every 5 rounds starting at 1: 1,6,11,16. Yes round16 is broadcast round. So we should broadcast norm message. So actions: contribute and broadcast.

Compute amount: 156.88 (round to maybe two decimals). Ensure not exceed wallet 196.1.
